card.title: Your First Young
card.lead: 2 young were born to you and #198. Each body is a real mixture of its parents'.

young.head: #201 · male
lines: Both of you carried: grazing mouth, simple eye, small torso, spring leg
New in this body: digging forelimb
Developed from inherited traits: walking leg → spring leg ×2
Compared with you: lower energy use, better digestion, lower disease resistance

young.head: #202 · male
lines: Both of you carried: grazing mouth, simple eye, small torso, spring leg
New in this body: storage sac
Developed from inherited traits: walking leg → spring leg ×2
Compared with you: better digestion, prefers warmth, smaller body

notes: Bodies are inherited. Knowledge is not: young that stay near you learn water, food, shelter and danger from what they see you do.
They depend on you while they grow. In about 30 days of growth one can be ready to carry the line on: press H to continue as them.
